notes.title: 1.1 Major Update: Bug Fixes and New Art!
notes.content: [p]Greetings Peakers, I hope your journey at the mountain Peak has been exciting and action packed. With this latest update we have decided to update the UI, add over 15 new animations and even add in a mini-game! Here is a full break down of what's new...[/p][p][/p][p][b]WINDOW CHANGES:[/b][/p][p]1. You asked for it! You can now change between scale modes to increase the size if you would like it to take up more of the screen.[/p][p]2. Small tweak of the window so when the you are in idle mode more of your actual screen space is clickable and its not as intrustive.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496333/556bf281c0571983bcdc3e150209897fd8b0dadb.png"][/img][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][p]Shout out to our bug testers and our wonderful coding lead for optimizing and fixing some messy code >w< and keeping the game clean and making it super fun !! [/p][p]Save data[/p][p]window size update[/p][p]visual glitches[/p][p]and a whole bunch of very important things to make the game better[/p][p][/p][p][b]UPDATED UI[/b] [/p][p]Our game finally looks like a game with brand new cleaned up UI. Within our new menu, we decided to add player stats to keep an eye on cool numbers during your journey together! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45496333/01084a274f1adc85eca809ed4d3301b3f051cea4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]NEW ANIMATIONS[/b] [b]AND A MINIGAME !!![/b][/p][p]Since our release, we've worked on making a few new emotes and attack animations. We're still working hard on creating an even wider roster to create the ultimate experience for you today and the future. [/p][p]Finally, an experimental add to the game that we hope you guys enjoy, a mini-game! We want to add a whole lot more and make each new one crazier than the last, but that's all folks! Please let us know what else you'd like to see and we'll see what we can do! [/p]
